sourceChecks.sourceText: The sons of Merari: Mahli and Mushi. These are the families of the Levites according to their fathers’ households.
sourceChecks.previousContext: The sons of Kohath were Amram, Izhar, Hebron, and Uzziel.
sourceChecks.nextContext: Of Gershom: Libni his son, Jahath his son, Zimmah his son,

sourceChecks.sourceText: The sons of Merari: Mahli, Libni his son, Shimei his son, Uzzah his son,
sourceChecks.previousContext: The sons of Samuel: the firstborn, Joel, and the second, Abijah.
sourceChecks.nextContext: Shimea his son, Haggiah his son, Asaiah his son.

sourceChecks.sourceText: The sons of Merari: Mahli and Mushi. The sons of Mahli: Eleazar and Kish.
sourceChecks.previousContext: The sons of Uzziel: Micah the chief, and Isshiah the second.
sourceChecks.nextContext: Eleazar died, and had no sons, but daughters only; and their relatives, the sons of Kish, took them as wives.

sourceChecks.sourceText: The sons of Merari: Mahli and Mushi. The son of Jaaziah: Beno.
sourceChecks.previousContext: The brother of Micah: Isshiah; of the sons of Isshiah, Zechariah.
sourceChecks.nextContext: The sons of Merari by Jaaziah: Beno, Shoham, Zaccur, and Ibri.

sourceChecks.sourceText: Of Mahli: Eleazar, who had no sons.
sourceChecks.previousContext: The sons of Merari by Jaaziah: Beno, Shoham, Zaccur, and Ibri.
sourceChecks.nextContext: Of Kish, the son of Kish: Jerahmeel.
